summary: Dynex Capital Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register up to 99,326,438 shares of common stock for an at-the-market (ATM) offering program. The distribution agreement was amended with multiple sales agents including BTIG, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and others. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices on NYSE (last price $12.64) through ordinary brokers' transactions, with commissions up to 2.0%. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or corporate event is involved.
